summary: Frontend-only test of Hero/Navbar empty-image bug fix (iter33). 23/24 assertions PASS. Verified: (a) when hero_image_url/nav_shield_url/nav_logo_url are empty, the corresponding tags are completely absent from the DOM (not just hidden), no broken-image icons or placeholders rendered; (b) nav-shield-placeholder SVG correctly removed; (c) when hero_foreground_url is populated, the image is anchored bottom-right with objectFit=contain, width=38%, height=45% of hero, top edge at ~55% from hero top (407px / 740px = 55.0%), bottom flush with hero bottom, leaving the top blue area fully clean of the kids image; (d) when hero_foreground_url is also empty the hero shows only blue+red multiply overlays + EDICION 2026 text, no img tags exist in the hero; (e) regression OK: 'FUTUR SOCCER CUP' Plane Crash navbar text, 'SOMOS MAS' text, no JS errors. Final state restored: hero_foreground_url=Unsplash kids image; nav_shield_url, nav_logo_url, hero_image_url remain empty.
critical_code_review_comments: Inline style objectPosition='bottom right' is auto-normalized by React/Chromium to 'right bottom' on the DOM element. Computed style resolves to '100% 100%' (correct). Not a bug, but if any future test asserts the exact inline string it should accept either order. Functional behavior is correct.

success_rate.frontend: 23/24 hard assertions PASS (1 cosmetic string-order mismatch, computed value correct)
